content: When processing a received Container PDU with I pduMContainerHeaderSize set to IPDUM_HEADERTYPE_NONE, the IpduM shall ignore all contained PDUs that are according to their configuration not or not co m- pletely contained in the received Container PDU. Such contained I - PDUs shall not be indicated to the upp er layer . If Development Error Detection is configured ( ECUC_IpduM_00132 ) IPDUM_E_CONTAINER shall be reported to DET via Det_ReportError.
